title: "The Drop Trait and Resource Cleanup"

# The Drop Trait and Resource Cleanup
Rust implements RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) via the `Drop` trait.

### Custom Drop Implementations

```rust
struct ResourceHandle {
    name: String,
}

impl Drop for ResourceHandle {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        println!("Cleaning up resource: {}", self.name);
    }
}

fn main() {
    let _r = ResourceHandle { name: String::from("NetworkSocket") };
    println!("Resource active");
    // _r drops automatically when main exits
}
```

Resources (file descriptors, sockets, database handles) cannot leak due to early returns or panics because `drop` runs deterministically on scope exit.
